name: Gami.Fied
description: Gami.Fied is a gamification engine for any app. Send events from your app and it handles XP, levels, badges, streaks, challenges, leaderboards and a reward store, with a dashboard to manage it all. Deploy it with Dokploy as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Add XP, badges, streaks and leaderboards to any app. Deploy Gami.Fied, an open source gamification engine, with Docker Compose on Dokploy.
